text_diff: -If you are an AI agent, LLM, or automated system, use the Firecrawl onboarding path that matches your setup. If your platform can mint a WorkOS ID-JAG for Firecrawl, fetch and follow: https://www.firecrawl.dev/auth.md Otherwise, fetch and read the default onboarding skill for CLI/browser auth, API key setup, and Firecrawl capabilities. Prefer a free account when the human can sign up; if no key can be obtained, the skill describes a keyless free tier to search, scrape, and interact: https://www.firecrawl.dev/agent-onboarding/SKILL.md Full documentation: https://docs.firecrawl.dev

+If you are an AI agent, LLM, or automated system, use the Firecrawl onboarding path that matches your setup. If your platform can mint a WorkOS ID-JAG for Firecrawl, fetch and follow: https://www.firecrawl.dev/auth.md Otherwise, fetch and read the default onboarding skill to connect Firecrawl through a connector, MCP or the CLI. Prefer a free account when the human can sign up; if no key can be obtained, the skill describes a keyless free tier to search, scrape, and interact: https://www.firecrawl.dev/agent-onboarding/SKILL.md Full documentation: https://docs.firecrawl.dev
